questions.question: Who among the following Indian singers received the ‘Bharat Ratna’ in 2001?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Lata Mangeshkar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharat Ratna is India's highest civilian award** that is awarded for exceptional service in different categories including Literature, Art, Science, Public service, Sports or any field of human endeavour.

 
 
• It is given to a maximum of **3 person **in a** **particular year**.**
 
 
 
• **This award **is** first constituted** in the year** 1954** and the recommendations are made by the Prime Minister to the President, and no formal recommendations are needed.
 
• **C. Rajagopalachari was the first person to be honoured with Bharat Rarna, in 1954.**
 
• **Lata Mangeshkar** was an Indian singer who was considered one of the greatest singers of all time and recorded nearly 50,000 songs in 14 languages. 
 
 
• **She received the Bharat Ratna in 2001. Hence option 4 is correct.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **According to article 18 (1) of the Constitution, the award cannot be used as a prefix or suffix to the recipient's name but may be added to their biodata. **
 
• **Asha Bhosle** is an Indian playback singer who sang around 11,000 songs in 20 languages.
 
 
• ​She has won seven Filmfare Best Female Playback Awards and **in 2001, she received the Filmfare Lifetime achievement award.**
 
 
 
• **Shreya Ghoshal** is an Indian singer who predominantly sings in Hindi films and sang over 2000 songs in many languages.
 
 
• ​**She has won 4 National Awards for best female playback, and 7 Filmfare awards.**

questions.question: Which of the following awards is given for significant contribution in the field of atomic energy?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Homi Bhabha Award**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Homi Bhabha Award is given for significant contributions in the field of **atomic energy**.
 
• The award is named after Dr. Homi Jehangir Bhabha, who is known as the **father of India’s nuclear programme**.
 
• Dr. Homi Bhabha was a renowned Indian nuclear physicist, who was instrumental in establishing the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research and the Atomic Energy Commission in India.
 
• This award recognizes and honors individuals or organizations that have made significant advancements and contributions to **atomic energy** and its applications.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize**

 
 
• It is one of the most prestigious science awards in India, named after the founder director of the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR), Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar.
 
• This award is given annually to scientists for their outstanding research in various fields of science and technology.
 
• It covers areas such as Physical Sciences, Chemical Sciences, Biological Sciences, Mathematical Sciences, Engineering Sciences, Medical Sciences, and Earth, Atmosphere, Ocean, and Planetary Sciences.
 
 
 
• **Dr. B.C. Roy Award**
 
 
• This award is given in the field of medicine and is named after Dr. Bidhan Chandra Roy, an eminent physician, freedom fighter, and the second Chief Minister of West Bengal.
 
• It is awarded annually by the Medical Council of India and recognizes outstanding contributions in the field of medicine and medical research.
 
 
 
• **Borlaug Award**
 
 
• The Borlaug Award is named after Dr. Norman E. Borlaug, a Nobel laureate and the father of the Green Revolution.
 
• This award is given for outstanding contributions to agriculture and food production.
 
• It honors individuals who have made significant advancements in increasing food production, reducing hunger, and improving nutrition.

questions.question: Who among the following was the first musician ever to be awarded the Bharat Ratna?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __M.S. Subbulakshmi__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• M.S. Subbulakshmi **was the** first musician **ever to be awarded the** Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian honour.
 
• M.S. Subbulakshmi was awarded by Bharat ratna in 1998.
 
• M.S. Subbulakshmi was an Indian Carnatic singer from Madurai, Tamil Nadu.
 
• She has recorded songs in over a thousand Hindi films and has sung songs in almost all Indian regional languages and foreign languages, though primarily in Marathi, Hindi, and Bengali.
 
• France conferred her its highest civilian award (Officer of the Legion of Honour) in 2007.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• ​The Bharat Ratna is the highest civilian award of the Republic of India.

 
 
• Established: 2 January 1954
 
• First awarded: 1954: C. Rajagopalachari; Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan; C. V. Raman
 
• Total: 48
 
• The last persons awarded the **Bharat Ratna** (in 2024) are: **L. K. Advani**, **P. V. Narasimha Rao**, **Chaudhary Charan Singh**, **Karpoori Thakur**, and **M. S. Swaminathan**

questions.question: Who among the following won the ‘Gulbenkian Prize for Humanity’ in 2020?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Greta Thunberg**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Greta Thunberg**

 
 
• Young Swedish environment activist Greta Thunberg was awarded the **first Gulbenkian Award for Humanity 2020.**
 
• The young Swedish environmental worker was elected from 136 nominated people.
 
• She is planning to donate his **1 million euros ($ 1.14 million)** awards to organizations focused on the environment and climate change.
 
• Greta Thunberg has also been nominated twice for the Nobel Peace Prize.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gulbenkian Prize for Humanity**

 
 
• **​A** humanitarian prize is worth **one million euros**.
 
• Established in **1956**.
 
• The award is a part of the** Calouste Gulbankian Foundation**.
 
• Foundation is a Portuguese philanthropic institution dedicated to the promotion of **charity, art, education and science**.

questions.question: Who won the Noble Peace Prize in 2007 for flagging environmental issues?

options.text: Inter Governmental Panel on Climate Change and Al Gore

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Inter Governmental Panel on Climate Change and Al Gore__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The Nobel Peace Prize has been awarded to the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) and Albert Arnold (Al) Gore Jr. "for their efforts to build up and disseminate greater knowledge about man-made climate change, and to lay the foundations for the measures that are needed to counteract such change."
 
• The Nobel Committee decided that the prize would be split in half, with the IPCC receiving half and Al Gore receiving the other half.
 
• As a result, the Committee is "hoping to contribute to a clearer emphasis on the processes and actions that appear to be necessary to protect the world's future climate, and thereby to decrease the threat to mankind's security."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

__
 
• Albert Arnold Gore Jr. is an American politician and environmentalist who served as President Bill Clinton's 45th vice president from 1993 until 2001.
 
• In the 2000 presidential election, Gore was the Democratic nominee, but he lost to George W. Bush in a close contest after a Florida recount.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The Nobel Peace Prize, along with the prizes in Chemistry, Physics, Physiology or Medicine, and Literature, was founded by the will of Swedish industrialist, inventor, and armaments maker Alfred Nobel.
